title: discovery_model
description: One AI model the Discovery station can pick, kept as data so a model is added or switched off in the Console (see DISCOVERY_GUIDE.md and DISCOVERY_MODEL_GUIDE.md). It holds the provider, the model name, the prices the cost estimate and spend cap use, and the NAME of the server setting that holds its key; never the key itself. Rules the schema cannot express: provider plus model_name is unique among live records; a model with is_active false cannot be run; the key named by key_name must exist in the server environment or a run on this model is refused; prices are whole cents per million tokens, rounded up when the real price has fractions of a cent (so a cap is never underestimated); fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept until the owner deletes it. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

provider.description: Which company's service answers: gemini (Google, through the Google project, no key), claude (Anthropic) or openai. A new company needs a new adapter in the code; a new model from a company we already have is just a new record. Required.

model_name.description: The model's name exactly as the provider calls it, such as gemini-2.5-flash. Up to 100 characters. Required.

label.description: The plain-words name shown in the Console picker. Up to 120 characters. Required.

price_input_per_million_cents.description: What the provider charges per million input tokens, in whole US cents, rounded up. Used for the estimate and the spend cap. Required.

price_output_per_million_cents.description: What the provider charges per million output tokens, in whole US cents, rounded up. Required.

search_price_per_1000_cents.description: What the provider charges per 1,000 searches when the model searches the web, in whole US cents, rounded up. Optional; absent means no separate search charge.

max_output_tokens.description: The most output tokens one call may use, which is how a step is kept inside the spend cap. Optional; absent means the provider adapter's own default.

has_grounding.description: Whether the model can search the web for real facts. A model without it can still run, but most of its facts will come back marked verify. Required.

key_name.description: The NAME of the server setting that holds this model's key, such as ICDT_CLAUDE_KEY. Never the key. Required for claude and openai; leave absent for gemini through the Google project.

is_active.description: The on/off switch. false means the Run tab does not offer this model and a run on it is refused. Required.

notes.description: Anything worth remembering about this model, free text up to 2000 characters. Optional.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
